Title: Get a Fullstack Developer (JS/Node.js) Job: Wisebits Vacancies

URL Source: https://wisebits.com/vacancies/162-fullstack-developer-jsnodejs

Markdown Content:
**Wisebits — is an international IT holding with a strong technical team!**

Our key product is a high-load video hosting platform used by millions of people worldwide every day. With over 15 years on the market, we’ve built a professional team that values engagement and initiative.

If you’re excited about working with a high-load product and want to have an impact on its development, join us!

**Who we're looking for:****Fullstack Developer (JS/Node.js).**

**What we expect from you:**

*   5+ years of professional experience developing large-scale projects.
*   Knowledge of Node.js 18+ and understanding of how asynchronous programming and multithreading work in Node.js.
*   Strong knowledge of SvelteKit, including Vite, TypeScript, and PostCSS.
*   Experience working with MongoDB, Cursor Tailing, and transactions.
*   Basic experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and command-line tools such as sh, bash, zsh, etc.
*   Familiarity with client-side pub/sub and WebSockets, either natively or using tools such as uWebSockets, SockJS, Faye, etc.

**Nice to have:**

*   Experience with PHP.

**What we offer:**

*   No bureaucracy — flexible working conditions.
*   An extended benefits package, including medical insurance, tax coverage, foreign language courses, professional training, and all necessary work equipment.
*   Relocation support: we cover relocation expenses for you and your family, including tickets, visa support, and the first month of accommodation.
*   A friendly international team that values professionalism and collaboration.

**Work format:**Remote.

**Salary:**From €4,000 net per month. The final compensation level may be higher and depends on relevant experience, skills, and overall match with the role requirements.
